items.name: blue-glass lantern
items.description: Cold blue light pools inside the rain-speckled glass, though no wick is visible.

items.name: ember tonic
items.description: A stoppered vial glows like banked coals and smells faintly of cinnamon.

rooms.title: Lantern Square
rooms.description:
Rain has polished the old stones to a dark shine. Beneath the clock tower, a few late travellers gather around a blue-glass lantern.

The illustration, when available, is atmospheric only; the text remains the complete source of playable information.

imageAlt.en: Lantern Square after rain, its dark stones lit by a blue-glass lantern beneath the clock tower.
imageAlt.es: La Plaza del Farol tras la lluvia, con las piedras oscuras iluminadas por un farol de cristal azul bajo la torre del reloj.

variants.description:
Rain has polished the old stones to a dark shine. The blue-glass lantern now answers your presence with a pulse like a distant star.

No hidden state is named here: the changed atmosphere remains complete playable prose.

imageAlt.en: Lantern Square after rain as the blue-glass lantern pulses like a distant star beneath the clock tower.
imageAlt.es: La Plaza del Farol tras la lluvia mientras el farol de cristal azul pulsa como una estrella lejana bajo la torre del reloj.

variants.title: Lantern Square at Midnight
variants.description:
Rain threads the midnight square in silver lines while the clock tower keeps its own counsel.

The blue-glass lantern offers the only warm point beneath the storm-dark roofs.

imageAlt.en: Lantern Square at midnight, silver rain crossing the dark stones around one blue-glass lantern.
imageAlt.es: La Plaza del Farol a medianoche, con lluvia plateada sobre las piedras oscuras alrededor de un único farol de cristal azul.

scripts.source:
function on_enter(ctx) tiamud.emit('set_flag', 'self', 'heard-lantern-whisper') end
function on_leave(ctx) tiamud.emit('narrate', 'self', 'The blue lantern dims behind you.') end
function on_look(ctx) if tiamud.random(2) == 1 then tiamud.emit('narrate', 'self', 'For a heartbeat, the lantern flame resembles a tiny dragon.') end end
function on_use(ctx) end
function on_talk(ctx) end
function on_combat_start(ctx) end
function on_defeat(ctx) tiamud.emit('narrate', 'self', 'The lantern flares as the struggle ends.') end
function on_timer(ctx) end
function on_quest_event(ctx) end
